title: Wire semantic Lambda runtime to current AWS storage and verified HTTP services
description:
Purpose: actual serverless runtime composition, not additional isolated service stubs. Prerequisites: accepted auth/HTTP, AWSstore and sampleGSI handoffs. Allowed new web/amplify/semantic/runtime.ts/runtime.test.ts and functions/semantic/handler.ts/resource.ts plus focused handler tests; backend.ts wiring and new semantic runtime CDK helper/tests if needed. Root owns package test registration. Exclusions browser transport, clustering, publisher changes, manual deploy or auth/model substitution; root reviews all IAM/dependency decisions.

Contract: runtime factory injectable DynamoDB SearchVectors/GetItem/Query send ports and bounded S3 reader; each invocation creates fresh AWSstore/cache, canonical hydrator with exact configured processingFingerprint, cloudsearch and relatedaudio services then verified HTTP handler. Module-level AWSclients/JWKS cache may be reused, canonical content/auth context may not. Environment trusted required semantic table/vector index/current Sample Recording Clip tables/storagebucket/Cognito poolclient/fingerprint/exact origin allowlist. Independent semanticSearchEnabled/semanticRelatedEnabled defaultfalse; invalid or absent required config structured503 no reads or inference. SearchVectors uses native index only, related uses sampleGSI, canonical GetItem consistent. S3 GetObject reads only configured bucket files/analysis prefix, stream cap16MiB enforced while reading not after unlimited materialization; NoSuchKey/404 null versus operational503. No external cloud inference/model download, no logging tokens/vectors/private data. Valid API Gateway v2 POST search/related uses current guarded metadata/playback and typed errors; disabled path no dependent operations. HTTPpublic guest never trusts request roles; signed access tokens verifier exact poolclient.

Infrastructure: defineFunction matching repository Node runtime; HTTP API routes only POST /semantic/search and /semantic/related plus strict allowlist preflight, TLS managed API endpoint. Narrow Lambda IAM SearchVectors exactnativeindexARN; Query exactsampleGSIARN; GetItem only threecanonicaltableARNs; GetObject only files/analysis/* configuredbucket; no Scan/write/publicvector access or broad grantReadData. No DynamoDB streams. Add custom output semanticUrl and independent flags via existing outputs convention. Synthesize in tests and prove routeintegration/environment/indexARNactions/no excessivepermissions/no cycle; backend runtime exports no manualdeployment. Avoid package upgrades unless blocker returned with exact evidence.

Gherkin: Given published ANN candidate and current source When guestquery Then playable visible hit; Given hidden/retired/boundarychanged/incompatible source Then excluded; Given curator then guest sequentialinvocations Then no crosscontext/cache visibility leak; Given relatedsamplemultiplepassages Then stored sourceGSIquery and diversifiedresults; Given invalidtoken Then401 no stores; Given disabled/invalidconfig Then503 no stores; Given oversized/missing/outage S3 Then exact safe result; Given cloud infrastructure synth Then scoped routes/IAM/environment and defaultdisabled. Fixtures full real native AttributeValue/file SHA bytes plus deterministicSearchVectors results, locally signedRSA JWKS, no liveCognito credentials. Verify runtime/handler/CDK focusedtsx bothTS fullsemantic and CIregistry rootcwd, zero skips. Handoff REDGREENdiffcounts fullrequestflow explicit retainedlimits AWSsandboxANN/deployment/browser/mobile/listening not claims. Subagent no commitpushcloseKanbus/deploy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Supervisor preliminary runtime proof: nonempty invalid Cognito pool configuration causes createSemanticRuntime.handle to throw uncaught Error before HTTP boundary, instead of required sanitized503. Test exact invalid pool/origin/config plus disabled operations before verifier construction. Origins should parse exact URL.origin (no path/userinfo/wildcard), and runtime constructor/port failures must never escape raw. Also web/package.json was edited despite root-owned registration exclusion; root will reconcile exact lists after handoff, no dependency expansion accepted. Continue bounded scope; root waits for terminal handoff before edits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terminal handoff is incomplete: three runtime tests are not full current-visible signed request flow and backend/API/IAM/output wiring absent. Missing deployed origin is not a reason to omit infrastructure: supervisor decision use trusted deployment parameter SemanticAllowedOrigins String default empty, independent enable parameters default false, fingerprint parameter default empty; runtime returns503 until valid exact origins/fingerprint configured. No guessed host or automatic enable. Return correct invalidpool uncaught error, strict origins URL.origin/no path/userinfo/wildcard, full signedRSA candidate-to-current-hit/hidden-retired-boundary/hash/curatorguest integration fixtures, streamingfailure tests, narrow CDK routes/IAM/env/customoutputs and dependency-cycle proof. Preserve defaultdisabled and no deployment.

right_now_summary: The runtime handoff is incomplete; validation, signed-flow tests, and API, IAM, and output wiring remain.
